baseline.edgePolicy: follow latest minor behavior where safe

components.name: Table
components.notes: Supports columns, dataSource, rowKey, loading, emptyText, pagination, bodyCell/empty slots, single-column sortState, checkbox rowSelection, preserveSelectedRowKeys, and accessible selection labels. Filters, multi-column sorting, expandable rows, fixed columns, and virtual scrolling remain out of scope.

components.name: DatePicker
components.notes: Supports single-date selection, controlled/uncontrolled value flow, allowClear, format, disabled, and FormItem status linkage. showTime and advanced calendar modes remain out of scope.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.notes: Supports minimal range query workflows with controlled/uncontrolled values, allowClear, format, auto-ordering, and FormItem status linkage. Presets, showTime, disabledDate, and alternate range modes remain out of scope.

components.name: ProSearchTable
components.notes: Supports text/select/date/dateRange/cascader search schema, formValues/queryValues layering, sortState in lifecycle payloads, rowSelection, bulkActions, retry pipeline integration, deterministic browser gates, consumer delivery, and page-level List Pack proof through shared status mapping plus reusable query and batch-action building blocks. Inline edit, saved views, remote schema builders, and multi-column sorting remain out of scope.

release.notes: Publishable package contracts, tarball-based consumer smoke, changeset status, size budgets, and release dry-run are in place. Real registry publish, credentials, and the final license decision remain manual.

completedPacks.name: List Pack
completedPacks.proof: The pro-basic playground scenario now proves query, shared status mapping, selection, and bulk actions together on top of ProSearchTable.

nextQueue.name: Detail Pack
nextQueue.goal: Make list-to-detail a standard read-only admin pattern instead of page-specific glue.

nextQueue.name: Edit Pack
nextQueue.goal: Standardize create and edit flows around one drawer-based contract with refresh wiring.
